headline: Critical PHP flaws, found with AI, trigger global patch scramble
summary: Two critical PHP vulnerabilities (PHP2Shell), reportedly uncovered with AI tools and rated with a severity score of 9.2, prompted emergency patches, government website shutdowns, and millions of exploitation attempts beginning days before fixes shipped. A third bug surfaced later without an emergency fix. Outlets differ on who gets credit for the discovery, how the initial warning was sourced, which governments acted, and what counts as an "AI-assisted attack."
